recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast minimalist composition featuring a stark white background, a single organic element (a red rose) positioned at the top left, and a sophisticated typographic system using both large-scale ghosted text and small, precise serif elements with a signature red accent block.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between organic floral curves and rigid geometric typography
Balance between extreme white space and dense corner-weighted elements
Relationship between the vibrant red of the rose and the red typographic highlight block
Interaction between the large-scale vertical background text and the horizontal foreground title
coreInvariants: Asymmetric layout with heavy left-side vertical emphasis
Use of a red accent color to link visual and textual elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A single red rose is cropped at the top left corner. Large vertical text runs down the left margin at approximately 25% width. The main title is positioned in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red rose in the top left and the red rectangular block in the bottom right create a diagonal visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the rose, follows the vertical text down the left side, then moves across the white space to the horizontal title in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space occupies the center and right-center of the frame, creating a sense of clinical cleanliness.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation red accents and low-value black text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a high-contrast serif with sharp terminals
Background text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with low opacity
Secondary metadata uses a condensed, heavy sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on scale and opacity variations
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a delicate, high-contrast serif and a heavy, low-opacity geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Solid red rectangular block behind specific words

preserve: The vertical orientation of the large background text
The high-contrast serif for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast serif elegance for the title.
Provides the geometric weight needed for the ghosted background text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a stark white canvas with a single, hyper-realistic red rose positioned in the top left corner, partially cropped. Include a very large, light gray vertical text element running down the left side with 10% opacity.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the bottom right using a black serif font in all caps. Place a solid red rectangle behind the final word of the title, changing that word's color to white.

verificationChecks: Is the red block aligned perfectly with the text it highlights?
Is the vertical text sufficiently transparent to not distract from the main title?
Is the rose cropped at the top and left edges?

adjustableVariables: Position of the red highlight block
Type of flower used in the top left
Tracking width of the serif title
mustRedesign: Any specific logos or brand-identifying symbols
Copyright/Metadata text blocks in the top right
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red of the flower matches the red of the text block.
Verify the vertical text is rotated exactly 90 degrees.
Check that the serif font has high enough contrast for an elegant look.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine one organic corner element + one ghosted vertical background text + one horizontal serif title with a color-block highlight on a white field.
